Remark
[parallel extension of a $p$-form via holonomy invariance]

Source: petersen:page-0407 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-holonomy-properties 1. ch10:10.5.27Consider a Riemannian manifold $M$ and a $p$-form $\omega $ on $T_pM$. Show that $\omega $ extends to a parallel form on $M$ if and only if $\omega $ is invariant under $\mathrm{Hol}_p(M)$.
